name: Feed the level view, preview and thumbnails from Nox
body: `src/ViewportRenderers.nox` registers the level view as `level`, the asset preview as `preview` and each template's thumbnail as `thumbnail:<id>`. Each renders through `lantern:::editorbackend` into the viewport's frame at its content size in physical pixels. The level view takes the pointer, buttons, wheel and keys; the preview spins at 0.6 rad/s.
